design_law: The Showcase must communicate the action without DEBUG logs.
known_limitations: Browser end-to-end capture was not asserted from the build environment because local Chromium headless had DBus issues.
Motion quality still needs human review from a real recorded public run.
V4 is a demo engine/lab, not a finished product UI.
Gesture assets are transformed from user-supplied reference imagery; keep provenance documented.
next: Record the public Showcase and inspect it frame-by-frame.
Repair any remaining continuity, pacing, targeting, contrast, or locality failures.
Connect Demo Engine V4 to the Visual Factory four-variant batch using one semantic script.
forbidden_regressions: drag or resize detached from pointer
raw debug logs visible in Showcase
decorative motion with no explanatory role
primitive failure aborting the whole demo when a local fallback is possible
